g.text: Admit the exact release before deploying it
06 / AGENT DELIVERY OPA is a bounded CI decision, not a Kubernetes admission webhook.
1 / BUILD THE COMPLETE INPUT AND DECIDE
Use owned values and actual model UID.
Full specs; no silent extra resources.
2 / BIND, RECHECK, THEN EXECUTE THE RETAINED DEPLOYMENT
Changed input, manifest or model UID
RECORDED POLICY CHECKS / ORIGINAL OUTCOMES RETAINED
